text:
Leah (CS): FYI Greenfield Systems renewal hit procurement. They want a 6-month amendment (shorter term) + wet signature for legal due to their controls. onboarding paused until payment/exec signoff :confused:
Omar (AE): do they have a PO? if not we should send an invoice stub and SOW PDF they can attach to their PO ticket
Leah (CS): they don't have PO yet. asked for vendor code and remittance address. procurement said: 'we require wet-signed amendment on company letterhead' and asked for bank wire details on invoice
Priya (Finance): we can add wire instructions to the manual invoice. what billing entity should appear? Greenfield mentioned two names (Greenfield Inc vs Greenfield EU GmbH)
Omar (AE): customer prefers billing to Greenfield Inc (US) for this renewal. asking if we can split invoices later if needed
Daria (Legal): send the requested amendment text. wet signature ok but need to confirm counterparty signatory authority. clause check: termination on 6mo term and no auto-renew. we'll need exec signoff line added
Leah (CS): uploaded amendment draft here: https://docs.redwood/greenfield/amend-1929 (customer-facing). also requested SOW PDF: https://files.redwood/sow/greenfield-sow-1929.pdf
Leah (CS): @invoice-bot please generate manual invoice stub for Greenfield Inc with wire instructions and NET30 terms so procurement can process PO faster
invoice-bot: created manual invoice stub INV-2026-0999 for Greenfield Systems. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/inv/INV-2026-0999
Priya (Finance): added wire details to INV-2026-0999. payment_terms=Net30, remittance="Bank of Redwood, ACH: 12345678, SWIFT: RWDXUS33" billing_entity="Greenfield Inc"
Omar (AE): procurement also asked whether we can accept a scanned wet signature instead of original wet-signed paper (they want to accelerate). legal?
Daria (Legal): scanned wet signature is acceptable if signed by authorized signatory and includes a notarization stamp per their country rules. confirm which signatory and we'll prepare a signature block
Leah (CS): procurement provided vendor code GF-2023 and approver name: Claire Nguyen. they said they'll submit PO once invoice and SOW attached. they also flagged they need 'service start date' explicit on invoice
Priya (Finance): updated INV-2026-0999: service_start=2026-05-01, vendor_code=GF-2023. status=PENDING
Omar (AE): I'll send the invoice + SOW + amendment to Claire and ask if scanned wet-sign acceptable. adding note: "please reply with PO # and approver email"
Leah (CS): next steps: 1) Omar to send package to procurement 2) Daria to prep signature block for scanned wet-sign 3) Priya to watch for PO and mark invoice PAID when wire clears 4) Leah to tentatively hold onboarding week of May 3rd
Omar (AE): sent at 11:23am PST -> emailed Claire with attachments. included a short FAQ: "what counts as notarized scanned sign" and requested PO by EOD
invoice-bot: payment status for INV-2026-0999 is PENDING (no payment event yet)
Leah (CS): procurement replied: "we can scan and notarize, PO in progress, expect PO# by tomorrow noon. will confirm approver email." they also asked for a PDF SOW (already sent) but requested invoice include 'deliverable: onboarding session x1' line
Priya (Finance): added line-item to INV-2026-0999: "Onboarding - 1 session". re-sent stub to Omar for approval
Omar (AE): approved final invoice stub and resent to procurement with amended line-item. chasing PO now
Leah (CS): Daria posted signature block for scanned wet-sign in thread: "Signed on behalf of Greenfield Inc by: Name, Title, Date, Notary seal (scanned)". asked OA to confirm signatory
Leah (CS): will keep hold on kickoff. if payment isn't cleared within 72h of PO we'll shift to recorded enablement materials and async tasks
Priya (Finance): reminder: if they wire, tag invoice-bot with payment_event and include reference PO# so reconciliation is smooth
invoice-bot: reminder scheduled: if invoice status changes we'll post update here
Omar (AE): procurement sent PO# GF-PO-5542 and scanned notarized signature attached. uploading PO to their ticket now. Can finance confirm once payment received?
Priya (Finance): will watch for incoming wire. ping me if any remittance reference differs. once payment posts I'll mark INV-2026-0999 as PAID and update this thread
Leah (CS): thanks team. keeping thread open until PAID then will send final kickoff invite. :pray:
